photos.title: Explorer
photos.caption: I'm always planning the next trip, with friends or on my own. New places, new people and new stories keep my head full of ideas.

photos.title: Graduation
photos.caption: I graduated from NIFT in 2024, and those years were the best roller-coaster ride I've ever been on.

photos.title: Game Night Host
photos.caption: I'm a big fan of board and strategy games. At our WeWork co-working space we'd book meeting rooms to teach new games to anyone curious. It grew into a proper board game community with its own tournaments, and the space came to love it.

photos.title: Building My Ecosystem
photos.caption: A year into my job, with freelancing on the side, I bought my iPhone 17 Pro and MacBook M4 Pro with my own money: the kit I use to learn and build interesting things.

photos.title: Mascots I Visualised
photos.caption: A gamified me in the middle, surrounded by the mascots I designed and visualised while working with consumer gaming and iGaming platforms.

photos.title: First On-site Job
photos.caption: In September 2024 I joined Metafusion, my very first on-site corporate job after graduating.

photo_frame.photos_note: Each photo: src (a path under public/photos), title (written on the print) and caption (shown under the stack while that photo is on top). frame_photo: which photo (1 = first) shows in the frame on the desk.
